title: TrainingPlanInputs
description: All information needed to generate a personalised running training plan.

goal_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the goal race (YYYY-MM-DD).

current_weekly_km.description: Average weekly running distance in km over the past 4 weeks.

longest_recent_km.description: Longest single run in km over the past 4 weeks.

recent_race.description: Most recent race or time-trial result. Used to derive VDOT. Optional.

age.description: Runner age in years. Used for Tanaka HRmax estimation.

resting_hr.description: Resting heart rate in bpm. Optional.

max_hr.description: Measured HRmax. If omitted, estimated via Tanaka: 208 - 0.7 * age.

days_per_week.description: Number of days available for running per week.

session_minutes_cap.description: Maximum duration per training session in minutes. Optional.

long_run_day.description: Preferred day for the long run. Defaults to saturday.

surface.description: Primary running surface. Defaults to road.

injury_flags.description: Active injury notes, e.g. ['left knee pain', 'plantar fasciitis']. Empty list if none.
